jobs.title: LECTURER.2.01 (AC.08.4)
jobs.reason: This role is for a Clinical Educator in Paediatrics & Child Health, requiring a medical degree (MBBCH) and current registration as a doctor. The candidate's academic background in International Relations, Politics, and Sociology, along with their research assistant experience, does not align with these fundamental medical and clinical requirements.

jobs.title: Associate, TMT
jobs.reason: This role is a poor fit primarily due to the significant seniority requirement of 5-8 years of relevant professional experience, which the candidate does not possess. While the candidate has strong research, data analysis, and policy writing skills, the job's focus on corporate communications within the TMT sector, financial situations, and established media/stakeholder networks does not align with their academic background in international relations and law.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftler:in (d/m/w) für das Projekt »UPTAKE«
jobs.reason: The candidate's strong academic background in International Relations and excellent research, data analysis (including Python and SPSS), and policy writing skills are a good match for the role's requirements. While the specific focus on climate policy and CO2 removal governance is not a primary stated interest, the candidate's IR background, workshop experience on climate transformation, and publications related to the German Green Party provide some relevant, albeit indirect, connections. The "PhD desirable" requirement makes this a slight stretch for a candidate with an MSc in progress and no full-time professional experience, but their strong academic record and relevant student assistant roles make them a plausible applicant.

jobs.title: Manager, Reward and People Operations
jobs.reason: This role in "Reward and People Operations" is a significant mismatch for the candidate's academic background and interests in international relations, law, and policy. While the candidate possesses strong general research, data analysis, and writing skills, the specific domain of HR operations is not covered by their experience. The "Manager" title also suggests a level of professional experience the candidate does not yet have.

jobs.title: Programme Advocacy & Coordination Intern - MENA Team (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: This role is an excellent match for the candidate. Their MSc in International Relations Research and BA in Politics and Society align perfectly with the think tank's focus on European foreign policy, and their student assistant experience provides direct administrative, coordination, and stakeholder communication skills. The internship level is ideal for someone currently pursuing a Master's degree with relevant experience but no full-time professional background.

jobs.title: Veranstaltungsmanager:in (d/m/w)
jobs.reason: The role at SWP, a leading foreign policy think tank, aligns perfectly with the candidate's academic focus on international relations and security studies, especially with 50% of tasks supporting the Center for Applied Turkey Studies. While the candidate lacks explicit event management training, their experience organising inter-institutional workshops and managing administrative tasks demonstrates strong transferable skills in organisation, communication, and stakeholder management. The seniority level is appropriate for a highly qualified candidate transitioning from significant student assistant roles to a first full-time position.
jobs.type: Full-time (100%), fixed-term until 31.12.2027 (with possibility of permanent), part-time possible.
